nodes.name: schema.rs
nodes.summary: Generates the LLM-facing JSON schema and description text for the AgentTool, including the dynamic list of subagent ids visible to the calling agent.

nodes.name: system_prompt.rs
nodes.summary: Assembles the full system prompt given to a spawned subagent, combining its agent definition, working-directory/environment info, conventions, and scratchpad sections.

nodes.name: tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the AgentTool orchestration flow, covering policy construction, message building, and subagent spawn/execute behavior.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the Agent Org tool implementations (inter-agent messaging and task management) for the orchestration layer.

nodes.name: send_message.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the org_send_message tool: validates sender authorization and message routing rules, then delivers messages between members of an Agent Org hierarchy with optional inbox-wake and self-abort hooks.

nodes.name: InboxWakeHook
nodes.summary: Trait for waking a recipient's inbox/session when a new org message arrives.

nodes.name: NoopInboxWakeHook
nodes.summary: No-op InboxWakeHook implementation used when wake behavior is not needed (e.g. in tests).

nodes.name: SelfAbortHook
nodes.summary: Trait allowing a sender to abort/cancel its own in-flight session as part of a send action.

nodes.name: NoopSelfAbortHook
nodes.summary: No-op SelfAbortHook implementation used when self-abort behavior is not needed.

nodes.name: OrgSendMessageParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for org_send_message: recipients, message kind, content, and work-context fields.

nodes.name: OrgRecipientTarget
nodes.summary: Resolved recipient target (member id plus session binding) for an org message.

nodes.name: OrgSendMessageTool
nodes.summary: The org_send_message tool implementation, wiring together recipient resolution, validation, and delivery with pluggable wake/abort hooks.

nodes.name: task_create.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the task_create tool for the Agent Org task system: validates ownership/assignment and dispatch policy, then creates a new task record.

nodes.name: TaskDispatchPolicy
nodes.summary: Encapsulates rules for how a newly created task should be dispatched/assigned to eligible members.

nodes.name: TaskCreateParams
nodes.summary: Parameters accepted by task_create: title, description, owner, eligible assignees, and metadata.

nodes.name: TaskCreateTool
nodes.summary: The task_create tool implementation.

nodes.name: task_graph_create.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the task_graph_create tool: creates a batch of interdependent tasks (a task graph) in a single call, resolving ownership and dependencies across the batch.

nodes.name: TaskGraphNodeParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for a single task within a batch task-graph creation request.

nodes.name: TaskGraphCreateParams
nodes.summary: Top-level parameters for task_graph_create: the list of task-graph nodes to create.

nodes.name: TaskGraphCreateTool
nodes.summary: The task_graph_create tool implementation.

nodes.name: task_list_get.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the task_list and task_get tools, letting an org member list tasks by filter or fetch a single task by id.

nodes.name: TaskListParams
nodes.summary: Filter parameters for listing tasks (owner, status, assignee).

nodes.name: TaskListTool
nodes.summary: The task_list tool implementation.

nodes.name: TaskGetParams
nodes.summary: Parameters for fetching a single task by id.

nodes.name: TaskGetTool
nodes.summary: The task_get tool implementation.

nodes.name: task_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Comprehensive test suite for the Agent Org task-management tools, covering create/list/get/update/graph-create flows, authorization, dependency resolution, and dispatch notifications.

nodes.name: llm_visible_agent_ids
nodes.summary: Computes the list of subagent ids that should be visible/selectable by the LLM given the allowed-subagents policy.

nodes.name: llm_description
nodes.summary: Builds the full natural-language description of the AgentTool shown to the LLM, enumerating available subagents.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters the AgentTool accepts (agent id, prompt, model, mode, etc).

nodes.name: build_full_system_prompt
nodes.summary: Composes the complete system prompt for a subagent from its agent definition plus environment, convention, and scratchpad sections.

nodes.name: worker_env_section
nodes.summary: Builds the environment section (working directory, model) of a subagent system prompt.

nodes.name: worker_conventions_section
nodes.summary: Builds the working-conventions section of a subagent system prompt.

nodes.name: scratchpad_section
nodes.summary: Builds the scratchpad-usage section of a subagent system prompt when a scratchpad is available.

nodes.name: parse_agent_org_remote_mode
nodes.summary: Parses a remote-mode string parameter into its typed enum value, erroring with a labeled message on invalid input.

nodes.name: with_hooks
nodes.summary: Constructs an OrgSendMessageTool with explicit wake/abort hook implementations, primarily for testing.

nodes.name: allowed_message_kinds
nodes.summary: Lists the message kinds a sender is permitted to use.

nodes.name: routing_description
nodes.summary: Builds the description text explaining how org message routing/recipients work for the LLM.

nodes.name: dynamic_llm_description
nodes.summary: Builds the full dynamic LLM-facing description for org_send_message, including current org roster context.

nodes.name: parameters_schema
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON schema of parameters accepted by org_send_message.

nodes.name: resolve_recipient
nodes.summary: Resolves a requested recipient reference to a concrete org member and session target.

nodes.name: build_message
nodes.summary: Constructs the outgoing org message payload from validated parameters and resolved recipients.

nodes.name: ensure_recipients_deliverable
nodes.summary: Verifies that resolved recipients are currently reachable/deliverable before sending.

nodes.name: validate_plain_work_context
nodes.summary: Validates that a plain (non-task) message's work-context fields are internally consistent.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Static fallback description text for org_send_message.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for org_send_message: validates params, resolves recipients, builds and delivers the message.

nodes.name: into_blocked_by
nodes.summary: Converts raw task-id parameters into a validated blocked-by dependency list.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing description text for task_create.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for task_create: validates ownership/metadata via TaskToolsContext helpers and persists the new task.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing description text for task_graph_create.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for task_graph_create: validates each node, resolves owners/dependencies across the batch, and persists all tasks together.

nodes.name: description
nodes.summary: Builds the LLM-facing description text for task_list.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execution path for task_list: resolves caller authority and returns tasks matching the requested filter.

nodes.name: execute_text_get
nodes.summary: Main execution path for task_get: resolves caller authority and returns the requested task by id.
